description: Shared-source-of-truth extractions plus the pure, deterministic, React-free Character Assistant engine behind a SuggestionSource interface, with full fast-check/Vitest coverage. This is the bottom layer every other FEAT depends on. Independent of FEAT-002/003 except that they consume its exports.
steps: Phase A extractions (behaviour-preserving; existing tests must stay green). (1) Add isReadyToAdvance(character):boolean to src/logic/advancement.ts moving AdvancementPage.tsx's inline `charsMet && skillsMet && talentsMet` (~L210-216) verbatim, reusing careerSkillMatches/getCurrentLevelTalents/CAREER_COMPLETION_THRESHOLDS; switch AdvancementPage.tsx readyToProgress to call it (keep the per-item checklist locals for display). Add `// Core p.48` comment.

(2) Add hasActiveEndeavours(character):boolean to src/logic/endeavours.ts (create the module if no endeavour-helpers module exists), implementing EXACTLY character.endeavours.some(p=>p.entries.some(e=>e.status==='pending'||e.status==='in_progress')); switch App.tsx showEndeavoursBadge to call it.

(3) Add calculateCarriedEncumbrance(character):number to src/logic/encumbrance.ts summing weapons (parseFloat(w.enc)), armour via calculateArmourEncumbrance, trappings via calculateCarriedTrappingEnc (honouring houseRules.ignoreBackpackEnc), coins via calculateCoinWeight; refactor the inline eW+eA+eT+eCoin call sites (GearTab + PrintLayout — confirm exact paths by search) to call it. Add `// Core p.293` comment.

(4) Create src/logic/reminders-target.ts exporting resolveReminderBaseTarget(character, def:ReminderTest):number moved verbatim from the private fn in src/components/combat/CombatDashboard.tsx (~L125); update CombatDashboard.tsx to import it (output unchanged).

Phase B engine. (5) Create src/logic/assistant/types.ts: SuggestionCategory, SuggestionUrgency, SuggestionAction (discriminated union navigate|roll ONLY), Suggestion (+ optional secondaryAction, citation, totals), SuggestionTotal, SuggestionContext {inCombat:boolean}, and SuggestionSource whose getSuggestions returns Suggestion[] | Promise<Suggestion[]> with the documented async-future-proofing comment. Reuse ReminderTest (reminders.ts) and DifficultyLevel (dice-roller.ts) in the roll action's test.

(6) Create src/logic/assistant/rules/{advancement,endeavours,encumbrance,corruption,reminders}.ts, each pure (character[,ctx])=>Suggestion[]: advancement (`// Core p.48`) xpCur>0&&isReadyToAdvance -> recommended navigate:advancement, xpCur>0&&!ready -> info 'N unspent XP' (+XP totals), xpCur===0 -> none; endeavours emit iff hasActiveEndeavours -> info navigate:endeavours; encumbrance (`// Core p.293`) read Strong Back/Sturdy levels as sheet-totals.ts does, max=calculateMaxEncumbrance(chars,sb,sturdy), current=calculateCarriedEncumbrance, emit iff current>max -> critical navigate:character/gear with totals from getTrappingEncBreakdown+weapon/armour/coin lines+getEncumbranceBreakdown and citation 'Core p.293: Overburdened'; corruption (`// Core p.183 + Pure Soul p.182`) threshold=getCorruptionThreshold(chars,getPureSoulLevel(talents)), emit iff corr>threshold (strict >) -> critical 'Corruption Test due', primary seeded Endurance roll {def:{kind:'skill',skillName:'Endurance',fallbackChar:'T'},difficulty:'Challenging',rollName:'Endurance (resist Corruption)'}, secondary navigate:character/notes, totals lines ['TB n','WPB n','Pure Soul n'], citation 'Core p.183: Corrupting (+ Pure Soul talent, p.182)'; reminders import/call deriveAllReminders and map CombatReminder->Suggestion (id reminder:${r.id}, rationale=r.description, category combat, urgency critical, action roll with r.test when present else navigate:combat, citation=r.citation verbatim).

(7) Create src/logic/assistant/ordering.ts (orderSuggestions: in-combat group order combat,encumbrance,corruption,advancement,endeavour; out-of-combat advancement,endeavour,corruption,encumbrance,combat; within group by urgency critical<recommended<info then id lexical) and src/logic/assistant/visible.ts (visibleSuggestions(raw,dismissState,now) pure filter dropping dismissed + unexpired-snoozed ids, no writes).

(8) Create src/logic/assistant/engine.ts: getSuggestions(character,context) ([] when !character; composes the five rule modules then orderSuggestions) and deterministicSuggestionSource:SuggestionSource (always-sync wrapper).

(9) Create src/logic/assistant/__tests__/ covering: determinism property, serializability property (JSON round-trip + no function values recursively, incl action/secondaryAction/citation/totals), purity (deep-frozen character + spied localStorage/navigate/dialog setters), per-rule triggers asserted against the REAL extracted predicates (corruption Pure-Soul-included strict >, overburdened current>max with p.293 citation + gear target, reminders equal deriveAllReminders mapped with citation verbatim), ordering (combat-first in combat / progression-first out), and the visible filter.
acceptance_criteria: isReadyToAdvance, hasActiveEndeavours, calculateCarriedEncumbrance, and resolveReminderBaseTarget exist as pure exports and their original call sites (AdvancementPage, App badge, GearTab/PrintLayout, CombatDashboard) produce identical outputs — verified by the pre-existing tests passing unchanged.
getSuggestions(character,context) is pure (no mutation/storage/navigation/dialog/network) and returns [] for an undefined character without throwing (asserted by the purity test).
Every emitted Suggestion and its action descriptor is JSON-serializable (property test) and carries a rulebook citation where it encodes a rule; reminder items carry r.citation verbatim.

Trigger tests pass: advancement iff xpCur>0 && isReadyToAdvance (+ softer unspent-XP branch; nothing at 0); endeavours iff hasActiveEndeavours; overburdened iff current>max with p.293 citation + character/gear navigate; corruption iff corr>getCorruptionThreshold(chars,getPureSoulLevel) with p.183 citation, primary Endurance roll, secondary character/notes navigate; reminders equal deriveAllReminders(...) mapped (reminders.ts imported, not forked or modified).
Ordering is deterministic and combat-first in combat / progression-first out of combat.
The pre-existing test suite passes unchanged.
verification: vitest --run src/logic (new engine/extraction tests pass; existing logic tests unchanged)
npx eslint . (0 errors, no new warnings)
findings:
IMPLEMENTED on current branch (no worktree). All four gates clean: `npx tsc --build --force --noEmit` 0 errors; `npm run build` succeeds; `vitest --run` 482 files / 5299 tests pass (pre-existing suite unchanged); `npx eslint .` 0 errors + 3 PRE-EXISTING warnings only (react-refresh/only-export-components in CommandPaletteContext.tsx, CombatPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx — none are files this FEAT touched, so NO new warnings). New assistant engine suite: src/logic/assistant/__tests__/engine.test.ts, 17 tests.

CONFIRMED CALL-SITE PATHS:
- isReadyToAdvance call site: src/components/pages/AdvancementPage.tsx (readyToProgress, ~L214; per-item checklist locals charsProgress/charsMet/skillsWithAdvances/skillsMet/talentsOwned/talentsMet retained for the progress-panel display).
- hasActiveEndeavours call site: src/App.tsx showEndeavoursBadge prop on <Navigation> (was the inline `character.endeavours.some(...)` predicate).
- calculateCarriedEncumbrance call sites refactored: src/components/pages/character/GearTab.tsx TWO blocks — (a) the Encumbrance Indicator ProgressBar (was `currentEnc = eW+eA+eT+eCoin`, ~L130) now `calculateCarriedEncumbrance(character)`; (b) the Encumbrance breakdown card (was `eTotal = eW+eA+eT+eCoin`, ~L591) now `calculateCarriedEncumbrance(character)` while KEEPING the per-line eW/eA/eT/eCoin locals for the displayed Weapons/Armour/Trappings/Coins rows.
- resolveReminderBaseTarget call site: src/components/combat/CombatDashboard.tsx handleRollReminder (~L189) now imports from src/logic/reminders-target.ts; the private fn was removed and the now-unused imports computeSkillTarget/computeCharacteristicTarget (dice-roller), ReminderTest (reminders), CharacteristicKey (character types) were dropped from CombatDashboard.

PRINTLAYOUT DEVIATION (behaviour-preserving, deliberate): src/components/layout/PrintLayout.tsx was NOT refactored to calculateCarriedEncumbrance. Its displayed encumbrance Total is `{eW + eA + eT}` — coins are EXCLUDED (there is no eCoin in PrintLayout at all) and it also calls calculateMaxEncumbrance WITHOUT a sturdyLevel arg (`calculateMaxEncumbrance(ch.chars, strongBackLevel)`). Substituting the coins-INCLUSIVE helper would change the printed total (a user-visible change) and break behaviour preservation / its integration test (PrintLayout.trappingEnc.integration.test.tsx). FEAT-001.json step 3's premise that PrintLayout computes `eW+eA+eT+eCoin` is therefore inaccurate for PrintLayout; GearTab was the only true `+eCoin` site and is fully refactored. If a later FEAT wants the print total to match the Gear tab (include coins), that is a product decision requiring user sign-off.

endeavours.ts was PRE-EXISTING (not created new); hasActiveEndeavours was ADDED to it (and a `Character` type import added). reminders-target.ts was CREATED NEW. isReadyToAdvance ADDED to advancement.ts; calculateCarriedEncumbrance ADDED to encumbrance.ts (which now imports calculateCoinWeight from calculators.ts — no import cycle: calculators.ts imports neither encumbrance nor endeavours).

CORRUPTION OQ-2 (> vs >=): implemented STRICT `>` exactly as FEAT-001.json step 6 and design.md §FR-8.4 both specify (Core p.183 'more than' WPB+TB, Pure Soul p.182 included via getCorruptionThreshold(chars, getPureSoulLevel(talents))). Not a guess — spec-resolved. OQ-5 (snooze duration/key) does NOT affect FEAT-001: visible.ts is a pure filter taking an injected `now` and a DismissState; it defines no duration or storage key (those belong to FEAT-002/003's dismissStore).

EXPORTED SIGNATURES FEAT-002/003 WILL IMPORT:
- src/logic/advancement.ts: `isReadyToAdvance(character: Character): boolean`
- src/logic/endeavours.ts: `hasActiveEndeavours(character: Character): boolean`
- src/logic/encumbrance.ts: `calculateCarriedEncumbrance(character: Character): number`
- src/logic/reminders-target.ts: `resolveReminderBaseTarget(character: Character, def: ReminderTest): number`
- src/logic/assistant/types.ts: types `SuggestionCategory` ('combat'|'advancement'|'endeavour'|'encumbrance'|'corruption'); `SuggestionUrgency` ('critical'|'recommended'|'info'); `SuggestionAction` = {kind:'navigate';page:PageSection;subTab?:string|null} | {kind:'roll';test:{def:ReminderTest;difficulty:DifficultyLevel;rollName:string}}; interfaces `Suggestion` {id,title,rationale,category,urgency,action,secondaryAction?,citation?,totals?}, `SuggestionTotal` {label,display,lines:string[]}, `SuggestionContext` {inCombat:boolean}, `SuggestionSource` { getSuggestions(character: Character | undefined, context: SuggestionContext): Suggestion[] | Promise<Suggestion[]> }.
- src/logic/assistant/engine.ts: `getSuggestions(character: Character | undefined, context: SuggestionContext): Suggestion[]`; `deterministicSuggestionSource: SuggestionSource` (always sync).
- src/logic/assistant/ordering.ts: `orderSuggestions(raw: Suggestion[], context: SuggestionContext): Suggestion[]`.
- src/logic/assistant/visible.ts: `visibleSuggestions(raw: Suggestion[], dismissState: DismissState, now: number): Suggestion[]`; interface `DismissState` { dismissed: string[]; snoozedUntil: Record<string, number> }.
- src/logic/assistant/rules/{advancement,endeavours,encumbrance,corruption,reminders}.ts: `advancementSuggestions(character)`, `endeavourSuggestions(character)`, `encumbranceSuggestions(character)`, `corruptionSuggestions(character)`, `reminderSuggestions(character, ctx)` — each returns Suggestion[].
